project.name: AEROLAB X4 — Drone Physics Engine & Wind Tunnel

user_request.summary: Build a high-fidelity interactive 3D quadcopter physics engine and wind-tunnel simulator with a 120 Hz force-derived rigid-body loop, controllable laminar/turbulent 3D wind, aerodynamic telemetry, payload picking, scientific authoring UI, history, adaptive rendering, and browser stability/performance verification.
goals: Implement individual rotor thrust, reaction torque, motor response, and gyroscopic precession.
Expose speed, yaw, pitch, turbulence, and air-density controls over one canonical 3D wind field.
Drive drone motion only from integrated forces and torques at a fixed 120 Hz step.
Render a detailed quadcopter, wind-tunnel enclosure, dynamic ground, pressure-coded flow particles, bloom, and ambient-occlusion depth cues.
Provide PID/manual/reaction flight modes, payload hardpoint picking, undo/redo, snapshots, and real-time plots.
Verify JavaScript structure, rotor-law invariants, calm hover, 30 m/s turbulent stability, and browser FPS warnings.
requested_constraints: Use modular ES modules under kits/.
Provide index.html and bootstrap.mjs using kits/runtime/frame-loop.mjs and kits/runtime/lifecycle.mjs.
Include kits/canvas/field-renderer.mjs, kits/three/post-chain.mjs, kits/three/lod-bands.mjs, kits/three/picking-gizmo.mjs, authoring stores, measurement series, and icon system.
Include scripts/browser_verify.mjs with a warning below 45 FPS and a maximum-wind stability case.
Use a clean scientific-grade HUD and accuracy-first causal rendering.

reversible_assumptions: Quad-X geometry with four identical rotors.
World axes use +Y up, +X tunnel flow, and +Z lateral.
Semi-implicit Euler translation and normalized quaternion angular integration are sufficient for the interactive time scale.
Payloads attach to four predefined underside hardpoints.
A lumped aerodynamic model is appropriate for interactive engineering exploration and is explicitly not certified CFD.

derived_constraints.name: WebGL2 rendering floor
derived_constraints.reason: The requested depth texture post-chain, true occlusion, material lighting, and spatial inspection require a GPU raster pipeline.
derived_constraints.benefit: Provides true 3D depth, depth-aware AO, emissive stress bloom, and high-throughput tunnel rendering in one browser surface.
derived_constraints.visual_cost: Browsers without WebGL2 receive an explicit initialization error instead of a reduced-fidelity fallback.
derived_constraints.rejected_alternative: Canvas-only pseudo-3D would not provide credible occlusion, camera inspection, or post-processing depth.

derived_constraints.name: Fixed-step catch-up cap
derived_constraints.reason: Unlimited physics catch-up after tab stalls can create a spiral of death and make the scientific interface unresponsive.
derived_constraints.benefit: Caps one display frame at twelve 120 Hz steps, equivalent to 100 ms of deterministic catch-up.
derived_constraints.visual_cost: Elapsed wall time beyond the cap is discarded after long stalls rather than replayed in slow motion.
derived_constraints.rejected_alternative: Unlimited catch-up preserves wall-clock time but can freeze rendering for seconds.

derived_constraints.name: Dependency-free raw WebGL2 scene layer
derived_constraints.reason: A self-contained package avoids CDN/runtime installation failure while still satisfying the requested kits/three module boundaries.
derived_constraints.benefit: The project runs from a static local server with no package install and retains direct control over buffers, depth textures, and cleanup.
derived_constraints.visual_cost: The model uses authored procedural geometry rather than imported photogrammetry or a large glTF asset.
derived_constraints.rejected_alternative: Bundling a large external engine and asset pipeline would increase failure surface and package weight without improving the physics source of truth.

considered: Open industrial test cell with the drone centered against a long recirculating tunnel and dense scientific rails.
Dark aerospace clean-room with a compact pressure chamber and holographic sectional diagnostics.
Outdoor atmospheric test range with terrain wakes and a portable instrumentation truck.
concepts.selected: Open industrial test cell with a long recirculating tunnel and dense scientific rails.
concepts.selection_rationale: The long tunnel makes wind direction, parallax, inlet machinery, wall boundary cues, and particle advection legible while preserving a central inspectable vehicle and a professional engineering UI.

representation.stack: Raw WebGL2 + Canvas 2D + scoped DOM/CSS hybrid
representation.ceiling_rationale: A runnable spike proved that the WebGL2 scene pass provides true depth, occlusion, spatial inspection and material lighting, while Canvas 2D is restricted to native-resolution field and telemetry overlays; DOM preserves precise scientific controls.

system.source_of_truth: WindField.sample(position,time) plus DronePhysics fixed-step rigid-body state
consumers: local flow probe and metric cards
attitude, power, and thrust telemetry plots

depth_roles: Immediate layer: native HUD, reticle, flow probe, force-vector overlays, and near tunnel beams.
Active layer: physically transformed quadcopter, rotors, payload hardpoints, and stress halo.
Context layer: receding enclosure ribs, inlet fan, ceiling luminaires, dynamic ground grid, and far airflow.
material_families: Graphite/carbon airframe with tight specular response and restrained cyan edge emission.
Brushed structural metal with brighter grazing highlights and high metal response.
Translucent tunnel glass with depth-sorted low-opacity panels.
Pressure-coded airflow marks with cool-to-warm velocity mapping and screen blending.
Amber/red rotor and payload stress emission feeding the bloom chain.
inspection_reveals: Close camera orbit reveals individual motor housings, rotor discs, payload hardpoints, and force-vector decomposition.
The telemetry rail reveals per-rotor thrust asymmetry, attitude history, and power demand against local wind speed.

fidelity.clarity_intent: Sharp scientific instrument panel around an atmospheric but geometrically resolved test cell.

interface.icon_system: Authored inline SVG symbol set in kits/ui/icon-system.mjs
interface.composition: Left authoring rail, central tunnel viewport, right telemetry rail, bottom solver/status strip.
interface.compact_recomposition: Below 980 px telemetry becomes a multi-column lower section; below 720 px all regions stack with contained scrolling.

input.camera: Left-drag orbit, wheel zoom, double-click focus.
input.picking: Click a highlighted underside hardpoint to attach or remove payload mass.
input.keyboard: Space pause, R reset, Z undo, Shift+Z redo, 1/2/3 flight modes.

validation.max_wind_case: 30 m/s, turbulence intensity 1.0, hover mode, 8 seconds
